scope: Static review only of the TASK-OSS-09 phase observability repair in .github/workflows/external-oss-v5-dependency-cache.yml, benchmarks/external-oss-v5/tests/dependency-cache-workflow-validation.mjs, and the corresponding G1 handoff/evidence boundary.

diffScope.details: The tracked patch is limited to the workflow and its corresponding static validator. Additional local files are review inputs and preserved evidence; they were not part of the tracked workflow/test diff reviewed for acceptance.

checks.name: workflow_patch_is_preparation_only_and_non_secret
checks.details: The repair adds TASK-OSS-09-only phase markers, a failure trap, and narrow diagnostics under artifact_root inside the prepare step. It does not add secrets, environment dumps, or non-preparation behavior.

checks.name: install_test_cache_network_and_ready_semantics_unchanged
checks.details: The TASK-OSS-09 install, public test, cache copy, runtime image capture, credential exclusion, measured-network exclusion, and READY manifest/result semantics are unchanged apart from surrounding markers.

checks.name: failure_phase_and_exit_code_will_be_recorded_for_the_missing_classification_surface
checks.details: The ERR trap records status, lastPhase, and exitCode to phase-failure.txt after phase_mark has already written before-task-oss-09-seed-reconstruction. That covers the observed August 1, 2026 TASK-OSS-09 failure surface, which occurred after clone/fetch began and before artifact upload.

checks.name: artifact_upload_captures_markers_for_the_reviewed_failure_path
checks.details: The upload step remains if: always() over the same artifact_root directory. Prior attempt-2 evidence shows upload still ran after the TASK-OSS-09 prepare failure and uploaded whatever existed in that directory. Because the repair writes phase-markers.txt before clone and phase-failure.txt on ERR into that same directory, the reviewed missing-classification failure path will now upload those markers.

checks.name: static_validators_pass
checks.details: Both required static validators passed locally in the reviewed worktree.

checks.name: blocked_full_local_validation_is_recorded_honestly_not_pass
checks.details: The handoff does not claim a clean full-suite pass. It records npm run ci as BLOCKED, and an independent bounded local rerun also timed out after 120.0 seconds while still in test:governance. No local npm ci PASS claim was present to accept.
evidence: python3 subprocess timeout 120s: STATUS=TIMEOUT during npm run ci while running test:governance

localValidation.boundedFullSuite: python3 subprocess timeout=120 on npm run ci => STATUS=TIMEOUT after 120.0s while still in test:governance

residualRisk: This is a static acceptance only. It does not prove the repaired workflow will produce READY cache receipts, pass offline verification, or complete a new dispatch successfully.

The marker guarantee established here is for the reviewed TASK-OSS-09 failure surface after artifact_root creation and the initial phase mark. It does not claim classification for hypothetical failures before that initialization point.
The local full-suite run remains blocked outside the repaired workflow surface.
claimBoundary: This static acceptance accepts the repair as safe and sufficient to expose the missing TASK-OSS-09 preparation classification phase in a future run. It does not claim a dependency-cache READY result, does not validate attempt 2 retroactively, and does not change prior task facts, oracles, contracts, workflow thresholds, or lockfiles.
